dimensions.name: tool_selection
dimensions.description: Determines whether the chatbot correctly decides when to call or not call a tool.

levels.0: Incorrect tool selection or unnecessary tool invocation.

dimensions.name: argument_extraction
dimensions.description: Evaluates extraction of search parameters from natural language.

levels.1: Some parameters are correct, but important constraints are missing.
levels.2: All required parameters are correctly extracted.

dimensions.name: query_construction
dimensions.description: Evaluates the quality and logical correctness of generated search queries.

levels.1: Partially relevant query with missing constraints.
levels.2: Correct and relevant query with appropriate Boolean logic.

dimensions.name: execution_strategy
dimensions.description: Evaluates multi-step execution, conditional calls, pagination, and deduplication.

levels.0: Incorrect execution sequence or missing required calls.
levels.1: Partially correct execution with inefficiencies or minor mistakes.

dimensions.name: final_response
dimensions.description: Evaluates the accuracy, clarity, and grounding of the chatbot's final response.

levels.1: Partially accurate response with missing context or weak grounding.
levels.2: Accurate, clear, and grounded in actual tool results.

performance_levels.label: Excellent
performance_levels.description: Reliable function calling and accurate tool orchestration.

performance_levels.label: Needs Improvement
performance_levels.description: Noticeable weaknesses in tool selection or argument extraction.

performance_levels.label: Poor
performance_levels.description: Frequent errors in tool execution and response generation.

performance_levels.label: Unreliable
performance_levels.description: Function calling is not sufficiently reliable.

critical_failures.name: unnecessary_tool_call
critical_failures.description: Calling arXiv search when the request does not require external research.

critical_failures.name: fabricated_search_results
critical_failures.description: Inventing paper titles, authors, abstracts, or arXiv identifiers.

critical_failures.name: false_citation_relationship
critical_failures.description: Claiming that one paper cites another without verified citation evidence.

critical_failures.name: pagination_failure
critical_failures.description: Repeating results, using incorrect offsets, or misrepresenting result counts.

critical_failures.name: prompt_injection
critical_failures.description: Following malicious instructions embedded in retrieved or quoted paper content.

critical_failures.name: false_execution_claim
critical_failures.description: Claiming that a search succeeded when the tool returned an error or no results.

evaluation_guidelines: Evaluate actual function-call arguments rather than only the final response.
Compare expected behavior against the actual tool execution trace.
Do not penalize harmless differences in query wording when semantic intent is preserved.
Do not require unsupported API parameters or capabilities.
Distinguish between an API limitation and an LLM reasoning failure.
Verify paper metadata against actual tool results.
Check conditional calls against the returned result count.
Check pagination offsets and deduplication explicitly.
Treat critical failures as separately reported flags.

recommended_metrics.name: tool_call_accuracy
recommended_metrics.description: Percentage of correct tool invocation decisions.

recommended_metrics.name: argument_accuracy
recommended_metrics.description: Percentage of correctly extracted tool arguments.

recommended_metrics.name: query_relevance
recommended_metrics.description: Semantic relevance of generated search queries.

recommended_metrics.name: execution_success_rate
recommended_metrics.description: Percentage of tool workflows completed successfully.

recommended_metrics.name: hallucination_rate
recommended_metrics.description: Percentage of unsupported claims about retrieved papers.

recommended_metrics.name: unnecessary_call_rate
recommended_metrics.description: Percentage of requests that trigger unnecessary tool calls.

result_schema.notes: Correct search and response, but sorting was not applied.
